social_media.headline: Ongoing Major Geomagnetic Activity
social_media.summary: Geomagnetic storm conditions are ongoing. Additional periods of major activity remain likely.
what_we_know: G5 conditions observed at 2058 UTC Friday.
Warning-level activity remains ongoing as of 0030 UTC Saturday.
There is a 45% chance of additional G4 or greater periods through 0000 UTC Sunday.

footer.left: Continue heightened operations and follow sector-specific procedures.
